research_question: Can Vadian BW V p.339 be linked with certainty to a Bucer→Vadian letter dated 1536-07-23, rather than a Zürich 1536-07-25 cataloged item?

evidence.title: Heinrich Bullinger Briefwechsel Nr. 875
evidence.supports: Bullinger→Vadian; St Gallen Vadiana Ms 33 (VBS IV) Nr.50; Vadian BW V pp.341-343; editorial note 3 cites p.339.

evidence.title: Heinrich Bullinger Briefwechsel Nr. 883
evidence.supports: Editorial regest: draft to Melanchthon, sending Vadian's eucharistic book after 22 Aug; date editorial bracketed.

evidence.title: Stadtarchiv und Vadianische Sammlung: Vadianische Briefsammlung
evidence.supports: Digitization/catal ogue project; manuscript digitals and edited extracts linked where available.

evidence.supports: Index candidate: Bucer→Vadian dated July 25; date from listing has not been compared to original.

evidence.title: Vadianische Briefsammlung V, second half

claims.text: HBBW 875 is a Bullinger→Vadian letter dated 1536-08-06.
The printed location of HBBW 875 is Vadian BW V pp.341–343.
HBBW 875 editorial note 3 cites Vadian BW V p.339 and characterizes Bucer's regret at not reviewing Vadian's Aphorismen before printing.
HBBW 875's regest reports Vadian's Aphorismen not fully printed by 1536-08-06.
A Zürich catalog-index candidate is a Bucer→Vadian letter dated 1536-07-25, Ms S 41, Nr.33.
There exists a fully identified Bucer→Vadian original dated 1536-07-23 at Vadian BW V p.339.
The July 23 item and Zürich July 25 Ms S 41 Nr.33 are the same letter.
The exact printed heading, entry number, and verbatim text on Vadian BW V p.339 are known.
St Gallen's modern Vadian correspondence catalog includes links to letter digitals and, where edited, edition excerpts.
HBBW 883 is an editorially dated post-22-August draft to Melanchthon that mentions sending Vadian's Aphorismen.

provenance_distinctions.reason: Identical numerals in different collections are not an identity match
Printed pagination is not correspondence number
Editorial gloss is a secondary interpretation of an earlier source

open_tasks.item: Obtain Vadian BW V second half pp.338-343 visual scan and identify entry header on p.339
Retrieve Zürich ZB Ms S 41 Nr.33 full catalog card, manuscript date reading and reproducible image link
Confirm WA Br 7 Nr.3048 exact source citation and wording against scan
Only then decide if 1536-07-23 and 1536-07-25 represent same, corrected, or distinct letters
